correctness.rationale: One-step error is e+ = (I−P_s)e with P_s=(As)(As)^T/||As||²; hence the largest uniform expected squared-error contraction is λmin(E P_s), sharp by choosing the min-eigenvector at step 1. Two orthogonal sketch-pairs (coordinates and dense signs) yield trace-one 2×2 average projectors. In singular coordinates their traceless vector squared norm equals r²/D[u²v²+(1−r²)(t−u²)²]; for κ>1, 0<r<1, unique maximum λmin occurs at t=u²=sin²2θ, independent of κ. Bernoulli occupancy p=2t/(1+t) follows by conditioning on nonempty support. Independently recomputed 2×2 matrices for θ=π/8,0.31,0.11 and κ=2,4.7,1.3; projector values matched formula and interior values beat both endpoints. At κ=1 all t tie, as explicitly excluded.
residual_risks: Bounds concern uniform per-step conditional expected squared error, not computational cost or long-horizon instance-specific spectral rates.
